SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_customers__returns__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "returns.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(returns.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "returns.amount_sum"
  FROM returns AS returns
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON returns.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.regions.name",
  _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.amount_sum" AS "customers.total_ordered",
  _cm_customers__returns__amount_sum."returns.amount_sum" AS "customers.total_returned"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum
  ON _base."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__returns__amount_sum
  ON _base."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__returns__amount_sum."returns.customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21

The null row collects orders and returns whose customer is unknown or has no known region. Each total was summed separately from the orders and returns tables, so neither is counted twice.
